app.name: LucidGrasp
app.summary: High-performance image search and similarity matching
app.description:
LucidGrasp is a high-performance image search engine built to identify and match visual media. It operates by analyzing images at the pixel level, combining structural patterns, color distributions, and keypoint features to produce a precise similarity percentage.
Key features include: - Color-invariant matching: Detects edited versions of images, including those with color grading or filters. - Two-stage search: Uses perceptual hashing for rapid pre-filtering and OpenCV (SSIM/ORB) for precise scoring. - Massive scale: Capable of indexing entire filesystems without slowing down search performance. - System integration: Follows system-wide light/dark themes and accent colors.
